title: WorkItem
description: A unit of planned work the fleet may pick up. Emitted by every SpecAdapter. See schemas/spec_adapter.go for the Go form.

id.description: Stable identifier within the spec source (e.g. issue number, RFC ID, milestone slug).

kind.description: feature: leaf, spawns one agent. program: routes through the planner first. See docs/design.md §Programs.

acceptance_criteria.description: Each criterion is a single falsifiable claim the agent must evidence with a citation. Text is IMMUTABLE post-publication.

citation.description: Evidence string set when state transitions to done. Format: 'test=<TestName>' | 'file=<path>:<line>' | 'commit=<sha>'.

dependencies.description: Other WorkItem IDs this one depends on. MUST be acyclic; the orchestrator only spawns an agent when all dependencies are done.

lane.description: Lane ID this item belongs to. Empty means default lane.

linked_artifact.description: URL or repo-relative path to deeper context (RFC, design doc, ADR, runbook).

source.description: Immutable pointer L0 uses to verify the criterion text has not changed.

locator.description: For kind=file: 'path/to/file.md:lineStart-lineEnd'. For kind=issue|ticket: the external ID.
